pdfjs.name: Mozilla pdf.js test corpus (test/pdfs, committed files only)
pdfjs.terms: Files committed to the public Apache-2.0 pdf.js repository for regression testing; mostly reduced documents from bug reports, individual documents keep their authors' copyright. Used here only for local testing, never redistributed.

pdfium.name: PDFium testing/resources
pdfium.terms: Test resources of the BSD-licensed PDFium project, fetched from the official GitHub mirror chromium/pdfium.
pdfium.notes: Only committed .pdf files (not the .in templates). Passwords from the embedder tests (e.g. encrypted.pdf user 1234 / owner 5678, encrypted_hello_world_r*: user 'hôtel', owner 'âge').

qpdf.name: qpdf test suite (qpdf/qtest/qpdf)
qpdf.terms: Test files of the Apache-2.0 qpdf project.
qpdf.notes: Passwords from the qtest scripts (user/owner, view/master, ...).

verapdf.name: veraPDF corpus (PDF/A-1/2/3/4, PDF/UA-1/2, Isartor, TWG)
verapdf.terms: Published under CC BY 4.0 by the veraPDF consortium / PDF Association as a public validation corpus; includes the Isartor PDF/A-1b test suite.
verapdf.notes: Atomic pass/fail files; file name says pass/fail for the clause in its directory.

bfo-pdfa.name: BFO PDF/A-2 test suite
bfo-pdfa.terms: Publicly published by BFO as a PDF/A conformance test suite (referenced by the veraPDF corpus README); used only for local testing, not redistributed.
bfo-pdfa.notes: description.txt in the repo explains each pass/fail case.

pdf20examples.name: PDF Association PDF 2.0 examples
pdf20examples.terms: Example files published under CC BY-SA 4.0 by the PDF Association.

pypdf-sample-files.name: py-pdf/sample-files
pypdf-sample-files.terms: Every PDF in the repository is CC BY-SA 4.0 (README).
pypdf-sample-files.notes: files.json in the repo has expected metadata.

pdfcpu.name: pdfcpu pkg/testdata
pdfcpu.terms: Test data of the Apache-2.0 pdfcpu project.

pdfbox.name: Apache PDFBox test resources
pdfbox.terms: Test resources of the Apache PDFBox project (ASF, Apache-2.0).

pdf-lib.name: pdf-lib test assets
pdf-lib.terms: Assets of the MIT-licensed pdf-lib repository.

pypdf.name: pypdf resources
pypdf.terms: Test resources committed to the BSD-licensed pypdf repository.

pikepdf.name: pikepdf tests/resources
pikepdf.terms: Only files with an explicit licence in the repository's REUSE.toml were taken; the per-file licence is recorded in each entry.

safedocs.name: PDF Association SafeDocs targeted test PDFs
safedocs.terms: Published by the PDF Association under Apache-2.0 (DARPA SafeDocs, approved for public release).
safedocs.notes: Unicode password tests: see the repo README for passwords.

zugferd.name: ZUGFeRD / Factur-X / XRechnung sample invoices
zugferd.terms: Apache-2.0 corpus of sample/test e-invoices; only the sample folders (XML-Rechnung, ZUGFeRDv1/v2 correct+fail from FeRD, FNFE, Mustang, intarsys) were used, not 'incoming'/'unstructured' real invoices.

arxiv.name: arXiv papers
arxiv.terms: Individual papers downloaded from arxiv.org/pdf (allowed by robots.txt, crawl delay 15 s respected); arXiv's distribution licence permits reading/downloading, not redistribution, so they are only referenced by URL.

irs.name: US IRS tax forms and publications (prior-year archive)
irs.terms: Works of the US federal government are not subject to copyright (17 U.S.C. 105); irs-prior URLs are stable per year.
irs.notes: AcroForm + XFA hybrid forms, PDF/UA tagged forms, scanned historic forms.

nasa-ntrs.name: NASA Technical Reports Server
nasa-ntrs.terms: Only records whose NTRS copyright determination is GOV_PUBLIC_USE_PERMITTED; robots.txt allows crawling.
nasa-ntrs.notes: 1960s scanned reports with OCR layer, modern presentations.

usgs-topo.name: USGS US Topo and Historical Topographic Map GeoPDFs
usgs-topo.terms: USGS products are in the public domain; fetched from the official TNM S3 bucket.

wikimedia-commons.name: Wikimedia Commons PDF files
wikimedia-commons.licence: per file (PD / CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-SA / OGL / GODL)
wikimedia-commons.terms: Freely licensed files; licence of each file recorded per entry from the Commons API (LicenseShortName); downloaded from upload.wikimedia.org with an identifying User-Agent.
wikimedia-commons.notes: Non-Latin scripts, presentations, maps, CAD drawings, scanned books.

ohchr-udhr.name: Universal Declaration of Human Rights translations (OHCHR)
ohchr-udhr.terms: The UDHR translations are published by OHCHR for free dissemination; files are fetched individually.
ohchr-udhr.notes: Many scripts; several older files use non-Unicode fonts (text not extractable).

govdocs1.name: Digital Corpora govdocs1 (thread0.zip subset)
govdocs1.licence: Public domain (US Government documents collected from .gov sites)
govdocs1.terms: govdocs1 is distributed by Digital Corpora for research use without restrictions; members are extracted from the zip with HTTP range requests.
